reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Storage version of `nodeclaims.karpenter.sh` changes v1beta1 → v1", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Existing NodeClaim objects remain stored as v1beta1 until rewritten; a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update must be done before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all NodeClaim objects and update status.storedVersions on the nodeclaims.karpenter.sh CRD before a release removes v1beta1.

proposed.statement: The storage version of the nodeclaims.karpenter.sh CRD changes from v1beta1 to v1, so existing NodeClaim objects stay stored as v1beta1 until a storage version migration rewrites them and status.storedVersions is updated.
